sar_narrative: The account of SYN_5cfe5cf6, an import-export trading firm, exhibits activity consistent with layering and pass-through behavior. Between 2026-02-02 and 2026-04-21, the entity conducted 30 transactions totaling $14,133,322.11, primarily via wire (82.1%) and ACH (17.9%). This volume significantly exceeds the declared monthly volume of $3,755,377.00. Upon verification, the auxiliary numeric finding of $10,000,000.00 is inconsistent with the underlying transactions; the re-derived total volume is $14,133,322.11. Behavioral findings indicate a loop was detected and the account interacted with 26 unique counterparties over a 7-day window, including PGHPT Services LLC and ZBJWZ Holdings LLC. This rapid movement of funds lacks a clear economic purpose and warrants further review. This matter is referred to a human investigator.
